function_creation.implementation: Copy the native descriptor before CPU compilation or asynchronous dispatch; resolve original named AIR entry and typed effective constants through the existing compiler and program cache. specializedName belongs to the returned function object, not the shader/cache identity.
function_creation.options: None and FailOnBinaryArchiveMiss use native A540 archive lookup by library content, selected name, resolved effective constants and library thread limit. A strict miss fails even with an empty archive list; ordinary misses use the existing compiler. Visible/intersection functions and unknown flags remain unsupported.
function_creation.archive_hints: Only archives from this device and exact build/OS/compiler/AOT profile are accepted. Cached AIR function hits still inspect declarations and resolve constants, but bypass AIR lowering and IR3 compilation and lazily register the stored pointer-free image through existing kernel JIT validation. Ordinary MSL source library creation remains eager.
function_creation.missing_constants: Required constants must resolve even when descriptor.constantValues is nil; ordinary newFunctionWithName: reflection behavior remains.
function_creation.ownership: Returned function retains the same dynamic program and device as ordinary named specialization; alias names/options are per returned object.

pipeline_creation.implementation: Synchronous and asynchronous selectors share the same validated existing render/compute pipeline state, registered functions and native IOGPU backend. Descriptor snapshots are taken before asynchronous dispatch.
pipeline_creation.options: None and FailOnBinaryArchiveMiss consult validated Compute/Render pipeline records and function identities; a strict miss errors and an optional miss uses normal creation. BindingInfo/BufferTypeInfo and unknown flags remain unsupported; reflection outputs remain nil.
pipeline_creation.compute_descriptor: Honor label, maximum group thread limit and execution-width-multiple promise. Cap each pipeline independently without mutating shared functions; reject an impossible fixed64-thread limit or execution-width limit. Validate the multiple promise when recording dispatch.
unsupported_descriptor_features: dynamic/preloaded libraries and additional/linked binary functions
pipeline_creation.async_completion: Exactly one callback for accepted nonnil handlers on the default global dispatch queue, with a retained supported pipeline or NSError. This reports CPU pipeline creation only; GPU completion remains native fence-driven.

apple_objects: Use original framework descriptors, constants and SDK signatures; do not redefine Apple protocols/classes or read descriptor ivars.
submission: Metal/IOGPU resource, command, event and IOSurface ABI unchanged; exact verified GPU1.71 backend reused.

native_call_evidence.source: 22H374 original Metal and QuartzCore analysis images; exact hashes and call windows recorded under build/drivers/gpu-native-pipelines
native_call_evidence.quartzcore_pipeline_call: 0x184409aac -> newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:options:reflection:error:, options4 (FailOnBinaryArchiveMiss), reflection null; original native archive-cache lookup path
native_call_evidence.scope: Static original image analysis, not execution of iOS methods.

remaining: archive support for remaining function kinds and automatic library/pipeline lazy compilation
dynamic function linking and remaining native descriptor SPI
system Metal loading, CARenderServer selection, native GPU/display fences and actual target execution

binary_archives.format: QMTLARC1 version1,112-byte header, SHA-256 over immutable complete file with digest field zeroed;256 functions,1024 pipelines,16 MiB and16 lookup archives
binary_archives.compatibility: GPU540, registry,Shader36,JIT33, fingerprint of adapter/compiler sources, native code generator dylib, AOT header and LLVM SDK ABI, then actual native OS version/build string, executed adapter build policy and Clang version
binary_archives.payload: AOT catalog references validated by name/stage/id and current registry; JIT images contain no process IDs/pointers and include the paired MSAA variant
binary_archives.pipeline_keys: resolved function identities plus validated execution state: thread limit/multiple, formats, color blend/write state, sample/coverage, vertex layouts; labels and per-process handles excluded
binary_archives.loading: bounded local read, complete checksum/schema/graph validation before any native registration; lazy weak registration cache, real kernel program/job lifetimes unchanged
binary_archives.writing: thread-safe snapshot, full validation and atomic local file replacement; duplicate pipeline functions accepted
limitations: normal pipeline descriptors receive already resolved function objects; archive function descriptors bypass AIR lowering/IR3, MSL newLibraryWithSource still creates its library eagerly
tile/mesh pipelines, stitched libraries, visible/intersection functions, Apple GPU archives and multi-device FAT archives unsupported
no complete Metal family claim or performance result; JIT privilege and independent ISA isolation requirements unchanged
binary_archives.target_probe: existing metalctl pipeline-test/jit-test, compiled only; save/reload AOT and JIT records, archive-only hit/miss, corrupt-file rejection, restored Compute and Render readback
